name: Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) Analysis for Covariance Estimation
definition: Derivation of the expected signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) when estimating the covariance of complex speckle fields empirically from images.
summary: SNR Analysis for Covariance Estimation quantifies the statistical reliability of estimating covariance between complex speckle fields, setting itself apart by providing a theoretical noise bound to guide window size and frame selection.
